title: Fine-tune the gate's greedy bots for Perfection
result: greedy-full-probe-perf passes rl-gate vs probe (+176 mean, 53.5% of seeds better) and becomes champion and frozen anchor; greedy-full-combo-perf closes combo's -415 gap to +16 and becomes previous champion (Jakob's decision)
question: Does a perturbation-probe tuning run in Perfection (Continents, 30 turns, share of points) make the gate's two greedy champions stronger in Perfection than the Domination-tuned originals?
change: No new mechanism: the training mode changes from Domination/Drylands to Perfection/Continents, and the metric from the finish score to the share of points. Two runs, one per greedy model in the gate: probe (champion and frozen anchor) and combo (previous champion).
method: Perturbation probe, 100k games per run, 10k games per round, sigma 0.25, z 3, step 0.5, league = the gate's opponents (greedy-full-probe, greedy-full-combo); 400-game final test against each panel model
measured: Panel curve every round and the final test, in Perfection
setups: Perfection, Crazy, 4 players, 16×16, continents, 30 turns, no human seat (trainer); then the rl-gate setup (Crazy, learner in the human seat) as a check
